text:
Noah Rivera: hey all 44b first day on product-design! quick blockers: 1) getting a 403 on the "Redwood UI - Components" Figma file, 2) which Notion page is the single-source roadmap (i found "Roadmap (draft)" and "Roadmap (live)"), and 3) where are recent user interview transcripts + who manages stipend budget?
Aisha Khan: welcome Noah!! Figma email? i'll add you to the Design team and the file. canonical roadmap is Notion > Product > Roadmap (Live)  the draft is archived until sign-off.
Noah Rivera: noah.rivera@redwood.ai thanks Aisha
design-ops-bot: Hi Noah 44b New hire checklist: 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #product-sync + #design-ops 3) Read Product Roadmap (Live) 4) Read Research Playbook and request Maze/Lookback seats. Link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product
Matt Lin: added you to the Figma file. re transcripts: Product > Research > Studies in Notion has recordings and transcripts (internal links to S3). design-ops handles stipends up to $500; bigger budgets go thru research ops + finance.
Noah Rivera: awesome, invite showed up 389 thanks. small process Q: if i want to run a quick usability test next week, what's the fastest path to recruit folks and get a Maze flow up?
Aisha Khan: quick path: fill the "lightweight study" form in the Research Playbook (link on the playbook). we run a triage every Thu; lightweight studies can be approved same-day if slots available. Maze seat requests through forms.redwood.ai/maze-request. i'll DM the template.
Sam Cho: FYI we also publish 2-3 line research summaries to #product-research after each study. for full transcripts go to Notion. if you need internal user cohorts (prod admins, enterprise customers) tag @Sam Cho and we'll route via CSMs.
Noah Rivera: thanks 44d another one: i'm planning a small tokens experiment to sync spacing tokens from Figma to the front-end. who issues plugin API keys and what's the safe workflow to test without affecting prod tokens?
Matt Lin: plugin keys issued by design-ops + eng-platform. workflow: create a feature Figma file, export tokens with the plugin to a draft branch in the design-system repo, open a PR labeled "experiment/tokens". platform runs visual-diff checks; any merge to main requires tag @platform-team and a 15m sign-off.
Aisha Khan: we can give you a scoped test key for the plugin so it writes to a non-prod branch. file a request in Notion > Design > Plugin Keys and tag me. also update the tokens changelog and include migration notes in the PR.
Noah Rivera: perfect, i'll file the key request. last practical ask: who should I ping to clarify an item on the roadmap timeline? i see a feature marked Q3 but the PRD mentions Q4 dependencies
Matt Lin: tag me (PM for core infra) or open a small note on the roadmap page under "Questions". we capture timeline clarifications as comments on the roadmap and snapshot weekly. if it's cross-team we escalate in the weekly roadmap sync.
Noah Rivera: thanks all 60a this is super helpful. i'll go through the onboarding checklist and ping if anything else blocks. excited to get into pairing sessions next week! :rocket:
